title: LiveAgentStreamState
description: live.agent-stream-state@1 (the Agent Streams plan, S1): what the desk reads every ten seconds, GET /api/streams/agent/:id/state on OpenVibe.Live (with the publish ticket). VIEWERS is how many people watch. ENCODE says whether Live wants video: it is true while anyone watches or the stream is public, and while it is false the desk stops encoding and sends a snapshot every five seconds (PUT /api/streams/agent/:id/frame, JPEG or WebP, at most 200 KB, with the ticket). CURTAIN is the desk's privacy screen (the reason is the owner's only). ENDS_AT is when the stream ends.

reason.description: Why the curtain is up. The owner's view only; a viewer never sees it.
